explanation: The AI response incorrectly identified the 2010 Final Four teams as UNC, Kansas, Kentucky, and West Virginia (the actual 2010 Final Four teams were Butler, Duke, Michigan State, and West Virginia). As a result, it missed Gordon Hayward (Butler) and included several incorrect/excessive players (John Wall, DeMarcus Cousins, Cole Aldrich, Xavier Henry, Ed Davis, Patrick Patterson, Eric Bledsoe, Daniel Orton).
